papers.authors: Son D, Chae Y, Yun T, Kim H, Lim JC
papers.abstract: Feline hyperthyroidism is one of the most common endocrinopathies in cats; however, its epidemiological characteristics remain poorly understood in South Korea. Although radioactive iodine therapy (RAIT) is a definitive treatment, studies focusing specifically on cats with hyperthyroidism undergoing RAIT are limited.
